sources.title: 肝炎ウイルス検査｜妊婦健康診査における肝炎ウイルス検査
sources.currentness: Current national hepatitis testing page rechecked 2026-08-13; HBs antigen and HCV antibody testing are included in antenatal checkups, and positive results require medical follow-up. Maternal HBV prevention policy remains active.
sources.reuse: Use current screening and referral facts in original wording. Do not reproduce leaflets, graphics or long passages.
